Tucked between the Austrian Alps and a glassy lake, Hallstatt looks unreal in person. Pastel houses stacked up the hillside, snow-capped peaks behind them, and one of the prettiest lakeside views in all of Europe.
If you’re planning where to go, here’s the practical version 👇

🚂 How to get to Hallstatt from Salzburg: easiest as a day trip train + ferry gets you there in about 2.5 hours, and the boat arrival is the view everyone photographs. 

🏔️ Best things to do in Hallstatt: the Skywalk viewpoint, the Salt Mine (oldest in the world), and just getting lost on the lakeside streets early before the crowds. 

🛏️ Where to stay in Hallstatt: book directly in the village if you want it empty at sunrise day trippers clear out by evening and it’s a completely different place.

Fun fact: there’s a full scale Hallstatt replica in China because the real one is that photogenic 🇦🇹

caption:
Steal my Mount Rainier itinerary 🏔️ I did the research so you don’t have to

Save this if Washington is on your 2026 bucket list. This park has it all wildflower meadows, glaciers, alpine lakes, and waterfalls that don’t even look real.

My perfect 1-2 day route 👇

PARADISE SIDE (Don’t skip this)
Skyline Trail - 5.5 miles - The BEST hike in the park. 360° views of Rainier, glaciers, marmots, and endless wildflowers in late July/Aug.

Nisqually Vista Trail - 1.2 miles - All the glacier views with almost no effort.

Myrtle Falls - 1 mile - The iconic postcard view of Rainier + waterfall. Go before 9am.

SUNRISE SIDE (Best for fewer crowds)
Fremont Lookout - 5.6 miles - Fire lookout with insane ridge views. Feels like you’re on top of the PNW.

Sunrise Nature Trail - 1.5 miles - Easy meadow loop if you’re short on time.

MY FAVORITE LOOP NEAR THE PARK:
Naches Peak Loop - 3.5 miles at Tipsoo Lake - Wildflowers + perfect lake reflection of Rainier. This is THE photo spot.

Add these if you have time: Christine Falls, Narada Falls, Reflection Lakes, Bench & Snow Lakes, Silver Falls

PRO TIPS to save you time:
1.  Paradise entrance gets full by 9:30am in summer - enter early
2.  Late July to mid-Aug is peak wildflower season
3.  No timed entry needed for 2026, but parking is brutal

Book a hotel directly in Hallstatt if your budget allows. Once the day trippers leave, the village becomes peaceful, quiet, and even more beautiful.

Rialto Beach in Olympic National Park feels like stepping into a moody coastal movie, towering sea stacks, massive driftwood, crashing Pacific waves and rugged Washington coastline in every direction.

Walk along the shoreline toward Hole in the Wall, explore tide pools during low tide, photograph the dramatic sea stacks and stay for one of the most unforgettable sunsets on the Washington coast.

🌊 Check the tide schedule before hiking
🥾 Wear waterproof shoes with good grip
📸 Visit early morning or around sunset for dreamy light
🌧️ Bring a rain jacket, the weather changes quickly
🪵 Never turn your back on the ocean or climb unstable driftwood

Mount Rainier National Park is one of the most breathtaking places in Washington State filled with wildflower covered meadows, glacier views, alpine lakes, waterfalls and some of the best hiking trails in the Pacific Northwest.

🥾 Best hikes and places to visit in Mount Rainier National Park:

🌼 Paradise
• Skyline Trail : around 5.5 miles round trip
One of the best hikes in Mount Rainier National Park for panoramic mountain views, glaciers, waterfalls and summer wildflowers.

• Nisqually Vista Trail : around 1.2 miles
A shorter and easier trail with beautiful views of Mount Rainier and the Nisqually Glacier.

💧 Myrtle Falls
• Around 1 mile round trip from Paradise
A must see waterfall with one of the most iconic Mount Rainier views. Visit early for fewer crowds and softer light.

🏔️ Sunrise
• Fremont Lookout Trail : around 5.6 miles round trip
A scenic hike with incredible views of Mount Rainier, mountain ridges and the surrounding wilderness.

• Sunrise Nature Trail : around 1.5 miles
A shorter option for alpine meadows and mountain views without committing to a long hike.

🌊 Tipsoo Lake and Naches Peak
• Naches Peak Loop : around 3.5 miles
One of the best summer hikes near Mount Rainier for wildflowers, lake reflections and postcard-worthy mountain scenery.
